# crDroid Patches v1.0

Complete **crDroid 16.0 / Android 16** source-patch collection, closing the
2026-10-01 publication work: four independent modules, 15 source patches,
generated standalone installers and reproducible release checks.

Implementation baseline: `f62057a0120f044d65278770fad17af96f0fdc5c`.
The `v1.0` tag freezes the complete snapshot, including these release notes.
No patch payloads were changed while preparing this release.

## Included module editions

| Module | Release | Scope and acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| aptX Adaptive / Lossless | [aptx-adaptive-v1.1](https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid/releases/tag/aptx-adaptive-v1.1) | Six patches; documented ROM/device acceptance on OnePlus 13 and OnePlus Pad 3 with FiiO BTR17. |
| GMS compatibility | [gms-fixes-v1.0](https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid/releases/tag/gms-fixes-v1.0) | Four patches; crDroid plus Evolution X vendor_gms `bka`. Source checks; public-edition ROM/device acceptance pending. |
| GPS server choices | [gps-servers-v1.0](https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid/releases/tag/gps-servers-v1.0) | Two optional GNSS configuration choices for OnePlus SM8750. Source checks; effective endpoints and GNSS measurements pending. |
| Donation requests | [donation-disable-v1.0](https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid/releases/tag/donation-disable-v1.0) | Three patches removing donation prompts/links and clearing old reminders. Source and documented host probes; ROM/device acceptance pending. |

The original [aptX v1.0](https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid/releases/tag/aptx-adaptive-v1.0)
keeps its original tag and release notes as a historical reference. Use v1.1
or this collection snapshot for the current aptX documentation and installer.

## Use

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pschmidt3200/android-patches-crdroid.git
cd android-patches-crdroid
git switch --detach v1.0
# Read the selected module's README before applying it:
bash aptx-adaptive/apply-patches.sh --check /path/to/crdroid
```

Modules can be selected independently. GMS's helper applies all four changes,
including the OnePlus package selection; GPS's helper applies both server
choices; donation-disable needs its full three-patch series. Read each
module's README, NOTICE and LICENSE and keep all files from the same tag.

Every module keeps a complete Bash installer. Python and the shared template
are maintainer tools, not runtime dependencies. GitHub source archives contain
source patches; this release does not contain a flashable ROM or vendor binaries.

## Release verification

Publication checks generator consistency, module structure, installer behaviour
and real check/apply/reverse-check/reverse roundtrips for every module at both
the NOTICE commits and current Android 16 branches (vendor GMS uses `bka`).
All temporary upstream repositories must be restored cleanly before publication.
The collection is published last and selected as GitHub's Latest release.

V1 freezes source editions; it does not turn the remaining GMS, GPS or donation
runtime checks into completed ROM/device acceptance. See each module's exact
source baselines and limits at this tag.
